out_of_schema_notes: The six findings, the root cause, the four contributing causes, the effectiveness check and the closure have no schema model; they are report_sections statements. Each corrective and preventive action, each plan approval date, each report's count of changed proven acceptable ranges and each verified platform worst case is a statement anchored on its own table row. The derivation table of §6.1 is not represented row by row: its criteria are the in-force records of acceptance_criteria.

acceptance_criteria holds the criteria-change table of §3.3: every Version 1.0 step criterion as superseded and every Version 2.0 criterion as in force. The Version 1.0 rule (R1 to R4) is the record basis; the R1 safety factors and the R2 capability means and SDs are in the assertions anchored on the safety-factor table and on the table of recomputed alert limits.

The capability records are simulated values the investigation reports: the Version 2.0 two-sided index for acidic variants, and two Version 1.0 values it corrects (the one-sided acidic variant index and the MVM minimum that PCMR-001 Version 1.0 reported).

Each viral clearance contribution carries the platform claim of its step as the step value, with the cumulative requirement and the sum of the claims (§6.1). The mean predicted LRF at the set-points and at the least favourable combination are in the assertion anchored on the same row of the viral clearance table.

The supplementary Protein A scale-down runs (S-PA-SDM2) are PD-005-01, a discrepancy from the plan PCP-005 that PCR-005 Version 2.0 records, and the investigation says they are not a deviation. The schema has no record for a plan discrepancy, so they are a StudyDesign (beside the planned qualification S-PA-SDM), an explicit non-claim and report statements. The deviation record DEV-005-03 of the previous annex is withdrawn.

The NOR and set-point changes at low-pH viral inactivation (PCR-006 Version 2.0) are stated in prose only; no table of the investigation names those parameters. They are report statements and step_has_parameter assertions, each on its own sentence, and not ProcessParameter records, which anchor on a rendered row. The parameter effects the investigation states (acidic variants at the bioreactor, host cell protein at Protein A) are assertions on the clause that states each.

The models of INV-002 corrective action CA3 (model selection) have no schema record. Their adoption, their use in the verification of the platform worst cases and in the reissued reports, and the XMuLV result on the selected model are report statements; INV-002 is a document relationship, and the adequacy of the models an explicit non-claim handled there.

The S-CEX-FRC method comparability replicates are not represented row by row; the mean differences are statements. The size-variant methods table anchors the SEC and nrCE-SDS method records on the rows that name each method and occur once in the document. The studies of the calibration table appear as the rows that anchor the equipment records.
No parameter or quality-attribute register of its own. No rhetorical_spans (none were curated). weak_claims is empty.
